value.rationale: The source presents diverging initial states numerically, which leaves an essential mathematical gap: an explicit open guaranteed escape region and its time scale. The result proves delayed flux, not instantaneous cubic flux, determines an exact double-exponential base and gives a doubly logarithmic threshold-clock. These determine robust continuum asymptotics useful to distinguish basin behavior; the limited sufficient-region scope is deliberate and not an unsupported global classification.
